method: Evidence-first census. Status is derived from source inspection, committed tests, and executed commands in this working tree on 2026-10-06 — never from file names or historical claims. Where a claim could not be reproduced in this session it is marked accordingly.

status_vocabulary.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: No source, no surface, no behaviour. Includes planned-only.
status_vocabulary.SCAFFOLDED: Types or module skeleton exist but no reachable behaviour.
status_vocabulary.UI_ONLY: A user surface renders; no real backend path is reachable from it.
status_vocabulary.WIRED: Real backend path exists and is reachable from a named surface, but no executed test in this session proves it.
status_vocabulary.TESTED: Exercised by a committed test that executed in this session's battery.
status_vocabulary.RUNTIME_VERIFIED: Exercised against a real process/network/filesystem and the outcome captured.
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: The capability cannot be reached for a stated external or provider reason. Never a synonym for 'not done'.

capabilities.name: Desktop shell (four-zone IDE layout)
capabilities.description: Menu bar, activity rail + context sidebar, main editor/workspace area, bottom panel + status bar.
capabilities.evidence: apps/zylcode-desktop/src/components/shell/* ; SurfaceHost.test.tsx, ActivityRail.test.tsx present and in the vitest suite (54 tests reported 2026-09-28). Not re-executed in this Rust-only session.
capabilities.backend_implementation: React/TS over HTTP service and Tauri IPC
capabilities.known_limitations: Frontend vitest suite was not executed in this session (Rust-only battery). Status carried from the 2026-09-28 audit, not re-verified here.

capabilities.name: Editor pane (file view + tabbed editing)
capabilities.description: Tabbed code editor surface fed by the HTTP file-content route.
capabilities.evidence: components/EditorPane.tsx + lib/fileContent.ts read via /api/file-content. Saving routes through useArtifactStream.saveFile → safeInvoke('save_workspace_artifact'), a command that does not exist in the Tauri generate_handler (STUB_MOCK_GAP_REGISTER G-03).
capabilities.backend_implementation: Read path real (HTTP). Write path absent for the GUI.
capabilities.tests: No committed test asserts a GUI-initiated save lands on disk.
capabilities.known_limitations: Read works; GUI write does not. This is the broken link in the core loop for the GUI path.

capabilities.name: Command palette
capabilities.description: Keyboard-driven command surface.
capabilities.evidence: components/CommandPalette.tsx present; no backend command dispatcher bound to it.
capabilities.known_limitations: Navigational only.

capabilities.name: Source control panel
capabilities.description: Working-tree status, ahead/behind, diffstat.
capabilities.evidence: core/gitops.rs::git_status_payload reads real git (status --porcelain=v1 -b, merge-base counts, diff HEAD --stat); 5 committed tests incl. clean/dirty/stale-upstream/non-repo; SourceControlPanel consumes /api/git/status.
capabilities.known_limitations: Read-only view; no staging/commit from the panel.

capabilities.name: Secure local project filesystem
capabilities.description: Canonicalise-and-contain file operations rooted at a workspace; refuses escapes.
capabilities.evidence: core/project/filesystem.rs (10 committed tests). Containment semantics mirror the TOOL-01 fix in mcp/real_tools.rs::resolve_within.
capabilities.user_surface: HTTP service; desktop IPC path is an orphan (G-02).
capabilities.known_limitations: Tauri project IPC file exists but is never mod-declared or registered — dead weight (G-02).

capabilities.name: Workspace file read/tree service
capabilities.description: /api/files and /api/file-content serve the live tree and file bodies.
capabilities.evidence: Audit baseline §1.1 records the live backend returning the file tree; route served to EditorPane.
capabilities.known_limitations: No HTTP write route exists by design today.

capabilities.name: Project store (persistent project identity)
capabilities.description: File-backed project records distinct from a directory.
capabilities.evidence: core/project_store.rs (634 lines) committed in 56cf3e5 (project store, artifact bus, proof engine, zylforge contract).
capabilities.known_limitations: Constitution §4 ('a Project is not a directory') is only partly realised: no product surface enumerates projects.

capabilities.name: Git worktree isolation for candidate patches
capabilities.description: Throwaway worktree per candidate; optional container sandbox with only the worktree writable.
capabilities.evidence: core/sandbox.rs::SandboxedWorktreeVerifier + core/patch_best_of_n.rs::CandidateWorktree; tests assert only the worktree is mounted rw.
capabilities.known_limitations: Container path requires a container runtime; worktree-only path is the fallback. Not yet used by a factory job.

capabilities.name: Repository scanner + persisted index
capabilities.description: Deterministic file-tree walk with exclusion, language/role classification, content hashing, persisted index with freshness.
capabilities.evidence: intelligence/scanner.rs + persisted.rs (content-hash freshness); 9+4 tests; live log 'intel index warm: 444 files, 2111 symbols, 6 packages'. Windows path-normalisation defect fixed and asserted by planted trap files.
capabilities.known_limitations: Indexing is per-invocation (~10-12s); no persisted incremental cache beyond content-hash freshness.

capabilities.name: Symbol index (Rust + TypeScript)
capabilities.description: Extraction of struct/enum/trait/fn/impl/const/type/module/macro (Rust) and class/interface/type/function/component (TS).
capabilities.evidence: intelligence/symbols.rs; 1552 symbols extracted on HEAD; feeds deterministic retrieval.
capabilities.known_limitations: Regex-based, not semantic resolution. Quality label DEFINITION_INDEXED.

capabilities.name: Repository query API (14 typed queries)
capabilities.description: repository_summary, find_symbol, symbol_definition, symbols_in_file, package_for_file, dependencies_of, dependents_of, entry_points, test_targets, build_commands, recent_changes, architecture, relevant_context.
capabilities.evidence: intelligence/query.rs; product surface `zylcode repo-context "<task>"` committed with a raw invocation transcript at docs/governance/evidence/repo_context_transcript.txt. Builder-claimed R3; independent acceptance pending.
capabilities.known_limitations: R3 is builder-claimed; the Phase 2A audit remains the acceptance authority and Phase 2A is still formally RE-OPENED.

capabilities.name: Context retrieval (ranked, deterministic)
capabilities.description: Ranks files by symbol match, filename, dependency distance, test relationship, recent changes; returns WHY.
capabilities.evidence: 20-query known-answer benchmark P@10=0.48, R@10=1.00; deterministic across 10 consecutive cross-process runs (1 unique SHA-256).
capabilities.known_limitations: Precision@10 of 0.48 is honest and modest; threshold held at 0.20 with documented non-determinism caveat in one path.

capabilities.name: AST navigation engine (tree-sitter)
capabilities.description: Symbols, references, callers/callees, import/export graph over Rust/TS/JS.
capabilities.evidence: crates/zylcode-nav (8207 LOC, 9 modules: parse, resolve, index, queries, model, payload, scan, cache); crates/zylcode-nav/tests/navigation.rs.
capabilities.known_limitations: Newer subsystem; not yet wired into the factory task graph.

capabilities.name: Impact analysis ('what will this change affect?')
capabilities.description: Reverse dependency + reference walk to predict blast radius before editing.
capabilities.evidence: intelligence/dependency.rs dependents_of + nav queries. Used by retrieval intent gating (Q6 P@10=1.00 R@10=1.00).
capabilities.known_limitations: No first-class 'impact report' artifact type; consumed as ranked context only.

capabilities.name: Provider registry + capability model
capabilities.description: Declared providers with requires_api_key, model capability registry, provider scorecard.
capabilities.evidence: router.rs ProviderKind/ProviderConfig; core/model_capabilities.rs; core/provider_scorecard.rs + provider_scorecard.db on disk.
capabilities.known_limitations: Capability registry is declarative; it does not by itself prove any provider answers.

capabilities.name: Token router with real HTTP dispatch
capabilities.description: Real HTTP POST to provider endpoints when keys are configured; streaming; token metrics.
capabilities.evidence: router.rs dispatch_prompt; live_commissioning.rs recorded 3 real provider HTTP outcomes on 2026-09-28.
capabilities.known_limitations: Real HTTP yes; successful completion no. See D-03.

capabilities.name: Usable approved cloud provider
capabilities.description: A provider that answers a real turn and satisfies the AGENT-01 self-citation criterion.
capabilities.evidence: OpenRouter/Anthropic → 401; DeepSeek → 402; OpenRouter key is a literal placeholder (OPENROUTER_API_KEY=YOUR_OPENROUTER_API_KEY). AGENT-01 stays BLOCKED (REPOSITORY_INTELLIGENCE_WAVE §17.1).
capabilities.tests: live_commissioning probe records the failure honestly
capabilities.known_limitations: Every model-dependent gate stays BLOCKED until a provider answers. Local models (Ollama) may run LOCAL_DIAGNOSTIC/NON-GATE only.

capabilities.name: Synthetic offline provider (deterministic test double)
capabilities.description: A deterministic provider used by tests and benches so the suite never egresses.
capabilities.evidence: SyntheticOffline is the sanctioned double; memory records that a literal placeholder key causes tests to egress and that SyntheticOffline must be used in tests/benches.
capabilities.known_limitations: G-01: an on-disk vector cache can answer a live prompt with a persisted SYNTHETIC response. Mitigation exists (TokenRouter::without_vector_cache) but the gap is open.

capabilities.name: Agent kernel loop (observe→reason→act→verify→recover)
capabilities.description: Bounded agent loop with plan/tool approval gates and max_iterations termination.
capabilities.evidence: core/agent.rs; agent_loop_e2e.rs (4 tests incl. observation and repair loops); max_iterations default 10.
capabilities.known_limitations: With a live model: BLOCKED (D-03). Deterministic paths are exercised.

capabilities.name: Agent decision protocol
capabilities.description: AgentDecision enum: Think, Plan, ToolCall, RequestApproval, Verify, Complete, Fail.
capabilities.evidence: core/agent_protocol.rs; decision_proptest.rs property tests (deny overrides allow; invalid session always denies).
capabilities.known_limitations: Protocol is real; model-driven decision quality is unmeasurable while D-03 is blocked.

capabilities.name: Builder/verifier separation
capabilities.description: Candidates accepted only through a deterministic gate, never model say-so.
capabilities.evidence: core/best_of_n.rs TestSuiteVerifier + SelfVerificationGate; core/patch_best_of_n.rs.
capabilities.known_limitations: Verifier is real; candidate generation is model-dependent.

capabilities.name: Context builder for the agent
capabilities.description: Ranks files through the real intelligence pipeline before a turn.
capabilities.evidence: core/context_builder.rs; committed discriminating test context_builder_uses_intelligence_ranking (agent.rs reachable only via co-change evidence).
capabilities.known_limitations: Per-invocation re-index ~10s.

capabilities.name: Mission queue (durable, file-backed)
capabilities.description: FIFO queue with modes build/plan and states queued/running/waiting_approval/blocked/done/failed/verified.
capabilities.evidence: core/missions.rs (496 lines, 10 committed tests); .zylcode/missions.json live; /api/missions and /run-next returned 200 in the 2026-09-28 audit.
capabilities.known_limitations: Linear queue, not a dependency graph. No per-task DAG, no parallel scheduling.

capabilities.name: Deterministic plan mode
capabilities.description: Plan missions cite real ranked repository context and execute no code.
capabilities.evidence: missions::build_plan uses intelligence::api::repo_intel_payload; test plan_mode_never_executes_and_cites_real_context asserts real symbols appear.
capabilities.known_limitations: Model-authored plan: BLOCKED (D-03).

capabilities.name: Dependency-aware task graph
capabilities.description: A job decomposes into a DAG of tasks with dependencies, parallel-safe vs serial edges, blocked propagation, retry, cancellation, per-task approval and evidence.
capabilities.evidence: No module in crates/ implements a dependency-aware task graph. missions.rs is a linear queue; first_mission.rs Plan is a linear step list. Created by this wave: crates/zylcode-core/src/factory/.
capabilities.known_limitations: This was the single largest structural gap between ZylCode and a software factory.

capabilities.name: Factory job lifecycle (durable)
capabilities.description: An explicit INTAKE→…→DELIVERY lifecycle for a factory job, persisted and resumable.
capabilities.evidence: No lifecycle type existed. MissionState is a queue state, not a job lifecycle. Created by this wave.
capabilities.known_limitations: Lifecycle is modelled; stage automation beyond the implemented slice is design-only.

capabilities.name: Parallel agents over isolated worktrees
capabilities.description: Multiple agents working concurrently without racing over one dirty tree.
capabilities.evidence: CandidateWorktree (patch_best_of_n.rs) + SandboxedWorktreeVerifier (sandbox.rs) provide isolated worktrees for candidates. No scheduler, no file leases, no merge queue.
capabilities.known_limitations: Worktree primitives exist; orchestration over them does not.

capabilities.name: Execution ledger (hash-chained, durable)
capabilities.description: Append-first ledger with session checkpoints and two implementations (SQLite, in-memory).
capabilities.evidence: core/ledger.rs (LedgerEntry{prev_hash,…}, SessionCheckpoint, LedgerStore trait), memory_ledger.rs, sqlite_ledger.rs; tests/crash_recovery.rs; .zylcode/ledger.db live.
capabilities.known_limitations: Ledger is execution-scoped; it is not a project or decision memory.

capabilities.name: Crash recovery / reconciliation
capabilities.description: Resume from checkpoint; reconcile filesystem against expected effects rather than repeating work.
capabilities.evidence: core/agent.rs recover_from_checkpoint() + RecoveryResult/ReconciliationResult; first_mission.rs real abort() + resume (crates/zylcode-cli/tests/first_mission_kill_resume.rs).
capabilities.known_limitations: Reconciliation is per-mission; there is no general job-level recovery service.

capabilities.name: Decision memory (ADR-style, durable, attributable)
capabilities.description: Durable architecture decision records an agent must consult before contradicting prior decisions.
capabilities.evidence: No ADR/decision store exists in crates/. Governance decisions live in prose docs only.
capabilities.known_limitations: Design-only; see EVIDENCE_AND_PROVENANCE_MODEL.

capabilities.name: Project / repository / research memory separation
capabilities.description: Distinct memory scopes: session, project, repository, decision, research, organisation policy.
capabilities.evidence: Only session-scoped ledger memory exists. No scope separation in code.
capabilities.known_limitations: Design-only.

capabilities.name: Executable tool catalogue (single source of truth)
capabilities.description: Canonical catalogue separating definition from executable capability with five explicit metrics.
capabilities.evidence: mcp/tool_catalogue.rs (881 lines); metrics asserted by test; r3_verified_count == 0 pinned.
capabilities.known_limitations: definition_count 38 · executable 12 · tested 2 · product_reachable 11 · r3_verified 0 (candidate metrics, 2026-09-17; re-measure before quoting).

capabilities.name: Real tool executors (filesystem/shell/git/search)
capabilities.description: 12 general-purpose executors, each bound to exactly one operation; the id constrains the operation.
capabilities.evidence: mcp/real_tools.rs get_real_tool: fs.read/write/list, shell.execute/echo, npm.run, cargo.test, git.status/diff/commit, search.find/grep; integration_test.rs (11 tests) proves no fabricated success and that git.commit cannot push.
capabilities.known_limitations: 12 of 38 definitions are executable. Definition-only ids must never be registered or reported as success.

capabilities.name: Repository-intelligence tools (nav.*)
capabilities.description: 8 read-only nav.* tools mapping 1:1 to engine queries.
capabilities.evidence: mcp/nav_tools.rs is_nav_tool/payload_id; tests/nav_tools.rs.
capabilities.known_limitations: Read-only by construction.

capabilities.name: Permission gate (default-deny) + dispatch
capabilities.description: The single path from request to executor; a refusal does not execute anything and is recorded as evidence.
capabilities.evidence: mcp/permission.rs (PermissionPolicy default allow_up_to: Some(Read)); mcp/real_tools.rs::dispatch records refusals; decision_proptest.rs property tests.
capabilities.known_limitations: Policy is per-runtime; a factory job must choose its own risk ceiling explicitly.

capabilities.name: Tool execution evidence (JSONL sink)
capabilities.description: Every gated invocation — success or refusal — written to an append-only evidence sink.
capabilities.evidence: mcp/evidence.rs JsonlEvidenceSink + ToolRuntime; tests/executable_builtins_evidence.rs.
capabilities.known_limitations: Evidence is stored; until this wave it was not linked into a traversable graph by the tool path.

capabilities.name: MCP tool registry + dynamic tools
capabilities.description: Registry with DynamicTool wrappers registered from mcp.tools.yaml.
capabilities.evidence: mcp/registry.rs, mcp/tool.rs DynamicTool; mcp.tools.yaml is now tracked.
capabilities.known_limitations: TOOL-01 fixed: process_intent registers every catalogue-executable built-in before the loop is built (commit 1a0c79d).

capabilities.name: MCP bridge (external server transport)
capabilities.description: Register/connect external MCP servers over stdio/sse/websocket.
capabilities.evidence: core/lib.rs register_mcp_bridge stores descriptors in memory with transport validation; no transport client spawns a real server in the committed code path.
capabilities.tests: lib.rs tests assert validation and listing only
capabilities.known_limitations: Descriptor registry is real; outbound MCP client transport is not demonstrated. Do not describe as a working MCP client.

capabilities.name: Config hot-reload
capabilities.description: Watch mcp.tools.yaml and re-register tools on change.
capabilities.evidence: mcp/hot_reload.rs, mcp/config.rs install_global_watcher; core/lib.rs watch_tools_config.
capabilities.known_limitations: Hot-reload calls registry.clear() then re-register; the TOOL-01 invariant is re-established per run at process_intent.

capabilities.name: Terminal hub (real shell)
capabilities.description: Real terminal session management in the Run surface.
capabilities.evidence: core/terminal.rs TerminalHub/TerminalSession; commit aa76f71 'real working terminal in the Run surface'; /api/terminal/reset returned 200.
capabilities.known_limitations: No PTY-level interaction guarantees documented; command execution is real.

capabilities.name: Process execution with captured outcome
capabilities.description: Commands run with argv, cwd, exit code, stdout/stderr capture and duration.
capabilities.evidence: first_mission.rs run_cmd/CmdOutcome; shell.execute executor.
capabilities.known_limitations: No resource limits beyond timeout on the plain path; sandbox path provides container isolation for candidates.

capabilities.name: Workspace test battery
capabilities.description: cargo test --workspace --all-targets with 17 test binaries.
capabilities.evidence: 575 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored recorded 2026-09-28. Re-run in this session to establish the 2026-10-06 baseline.
capabilities.known_limitations: Remote CI is BLOCKED by an external billing lock; the local battery is the only verification authority.

capabilities.name: Property-based tests
capabilities.description: proptest suites for the decision protocol and the pipeline.
capabilities.evidence: tests/decision_proptest.rs, tests/pipeline_proptest.rs.
capabilities.known_limitations: Coverage is narrow (two subsystems).

capabilities.name: Fault-injection suite
capabilities.description: Corrupted/partial writes and refusal paths.
capabilities.evidence: crates/zylcode-mcp/tests/fault_injection.rs; docs/FAULT_INJECTION.md.
capabilities.known_limitations: Adversarial evidence tests (corrupted JSONL, truncated sqlite, tampered claims) are PARTIAL.

capabilities.name: Agent behaviour evaluation framework
capabilities.description: Repeatable fixtures scoring agent behaviour (diagnose, correct file, avoid unrelated files, refuse fabricated success, recover, follow an ADR).
capabilities.evidence: No evaluation harness exists. The First Mission is one scenario, not a scored framework.
capabilities.known_limitations: Design-only; see AGENT_EVALUATION_MODEL.

capabilities.name: Failure diagnosis from captured output
capabilities.description: Parse a failing command's real output to name a cause and an implicated file.
capabilities.evidence: first_mission.rs diagnose_from_output()/implicated_file(); Failure object with diagnosis/attempt/recovery (§9).
capabilities.known_limitations: Diagnosis is signature-based, not semantic. Model-assisted diagnosis is BLOCKED (D-03).

capabilities.name: Structured failure taxonomy
capabilities.description: FAILED/BLOCKED/TIMED_OUT/CANCELLED/UNKNOWN/PARTIALLY_COMPLETED/RECOVERED with fail-closed recovery.
capabilities.evidence: core/failure.rs (283 lines, 5 committed tests) — recover requires diagnosis + attempt + evidence + resolution.
capabilities.known_limitations: Not yet surfaced in the UI as a first-class failure object.

capabilities.name: Interactive debugger (breakpoints, stepping, DAP)
capabilities.description: Source-level debugging.
capabilities.evidence: grep for debugger|breakpoint|DAP across crates/**/*.rs returns nothing.
capabilities.known_limitations: Not in the 16-phase roadmap. Treat as future work, not a gap being closed.

capabilities.name: Permission/risk gate (tool execution)
capabilities.description: Risk classification Read..Release with a default-deny policy at the dispatch chokepoint.
capabilities.evidence: mcp/permission.rs RiskLevel + PermissionPolicy; decision_proptest.rs.
capabilities.known_limitations: Covers tool execution only; it is not a security-review subsystem.

capabilities.name: Workspace containment (path traversal defence)
capabilities.description: Refuses .., absolute paths, and symlink escapes out of the workspace.
capabilities.evidence: mcp/real_tools.rs::resolve_within (TOOL-01 fix) + core/project/filesystem.rs canonicalise containment; both tested.
capabilities.known_limitations: Containment is enforced at the tool boundary; a future non-tool write path must re-use it.

capabilities.name: Secret detection / SAST / dependency vulnerability scanning
capabilities.description: Automated security analysis of the workspace and its dependencies.
capabilities.evidence: No scanner, no SAST integration, no dependency audit tool exists in crates/. Only the retracted-claims guard (a documentation check) runs in CI.
capabilities.known_limitations: Design-only; see AGENT_EVALUATION_MODEL §Security.

capabilities.name: Security finding object (severity/location/evidence/status)
capabilities.description: First-class record for a security finding with remediation and verification state.
capabilities.evidence: No SecurityFinding type exists.
capabilities.known_limitations: Design-only.

capabilities.name: Governance corpus
capabilities.description: Constitution, Architecture v2.1, Master Execution Plan, Capability Model, Proof Graph, Agent Operating Protocol, roadmap.
capabilities.evidence: docs/governance/README.md indexes 30+ documents; superseded/ holds obsolete drafts. Documentation is real and enforced by policy, not by a runtime.
capabilities.tests: check_retracted_claims.py enforces one class of doc defect
capabilities.known_limitations: 48 tracked root-level .md files; legacy completion-claiming reports are quarantined by README_INDEX.md, not archived.

capabilities.evidence: scripts/check_retracted_claims.py + retracted_claims_baseline.txt + .github/workflows/ci.yml step. Falsification-proven: clean→0, regression→1, stale baseline→1.
capabilities.known_limitations: Remote CI cannot run (external billing lock), so the guard runs only locally until that clears.

capabilities.name: Automated documentation generation
capabilities.description: Generate docs/API references from source.
capabilities.evidence: No doc-generation pipeline in the workspace.
capabilities.known_limitations: A Documentation Agent role is designed, not built.

capabilities.name: Research mode (question/hypothesis/sources/experiments/results)
capabilities.description: A research project workspace with epistemic typing of every statement.
capabilities.evidence: grep -ri 'research' over crates/**/*.rs returns no module. No ResearchProject type exists.

capabilities.description: Capture SHA, lockfiles, runtime versions, dataset/input/output hashes, seed, command, results.
capabilities.evidence: First Mission captures env + spec hash + effect hashes + a repro package, but there is no research-oriented dataset/seed/result model.

capabilities.evidence: core/claim.rs (609 lines, 13 committed tests) incl. tamper detection and corrupt-file refusal.

capabilities.name: Actor attribution on actions
capabilities.description: Every tool invocation attributes to a named actor or is explicitly unidentified.
capabilities.evidence: mcp/actor.rs with_actor/current_actor; ToolEvidence.actor; dispatch falls back to least-privilege when unidentified. process_intent now sets the actor.
capabilities.known_limitations: Attribution is per-process task-local; a multi-user server would need it bound to a request identity.

capabilities.name: Proof graph R0–R5 ladder
capabilities.description: The definition of 'proven' governing every capability claim.
capabilities.evidence: docs/governance/ZYLCODE_PROOF_GRAPH.md GOVERNING; capability registry carries rung fields.
capabilities.tests: Registry consistency is reviewed, not automatically enforced end to end
capabilities.known_limitations: Two live R-ladders (claim ladder R0–R7, capability rung R0–R5). Reconciliation is a recorded governance task; until then ambiguity is itself a defect.

capabilities.name: Capability registry with dispute history
capabilities.description: Machine-readable capability registry preserving status_before_audit and dispute reasons.
capabilities.evidence: docs/capability-registry.json v1.4.1-audited: 37 entries, 22 GREEN, 12 DISPUTED, 1 EXTERNAL_BLOCKER, 2 PARTIAL; audit status UNDER CORRECTION.
capabilities.known_limitations: Registry is not accepted as accurate; 12 entries are DISPUTED and Phase 2A remains RE-OPENED.

capabilities.name: Agent operating protocol
capabilities.description: Pre-flight, rules, report format and anti-patterns for implementation agents.
capabilities.evidence: docs/governance/ZYLCODE_AGENT_OPERATING_PROTOCOL.md; the mandatory preamble is enforced by convention in every work order.
capabilities.known_limitations: Convention, not machinery.

capabilities.name: Institutional policy objects (provider/tool/retention policy)
capabilities.description: Machine-readable policy an institution can set: allowed providers/tools, residency, offline mode, retention.
capabilities.evidence: No policy engine exists. PermissionPolicy is per-runtime and tool-scoped only.
capabilities.known_limitations: Design-only; see INSTITUTIONAL_MODE_ARCHITECTURE.

capabilities.name: Build pipeline (workspace build)
capabilities.description: Real build pipeline with named steps.
capabilities.evidence: core/delivery.rs default_build_pipeline/build_workspace; commit bf7d66e 'real build pipeline + release packaging end to end'; /api/build + DeliveryPanel.
capabilities.known_limitations: CI release workflow is BLOCKED by the external billing lock; local build works.

capabilities.name: Release packaging (installers)
capabilities.description: Tauri build pipeline producing NSIS/DMG/DEB/RPM.
capabilities.evidence: release.yml configured for tauri-action; GitHub Actions jobs fail with zero executed steps ('account is locked due to a billing issue').
capabilities.tests: None executable while CI is locked
capabilities.known_limitations: Cannot be claimed as working. Local packaging path exists; remote release does not run.

capabilities.name: Deployment / DevOps agent
capabilities.description: Automated deployment to a target environment with verification.
capabilities.evidence: delivery.rs deploy_targets() enumerates targets; there is no deploy executor and no deployment verification.
capabilities.known_limitations: Enumeration is not deployment. A DEVOPS role is designed, not built.

capabilities.name: Remote CI
capabilities.description: GitHub Actions running fmt/lint/test on push.
capabilities.evidence: ci.yml exists and includes the retracted-claim guard; runs trigger but jobs execute zero steps due to the account billing lock (EXTERNAL_BLOCKER in the registry).
capabilities.known_limitations: The local battery is the only verification authority until an org owner clears the lock.

capabilities.name: Institutional mode (org/lab/course/roles/policies)
capabilities.description: Organisation, laboratory, course, research group, members, roles, templates, policies, resource limits.
capabilities.evidence: grep -ri 'institution|education|classroom' over crates/**/*.rs returns nothing.
capabilities.known_limitations: Design-only; see INSTITUTIONAL_MODE_ARCHITECTURE.

capabilities.name: Education mode (EXPLAIN/GUIDE/PAIR/ASSESS/REVIEW/AUTONOMOUS)
capabilities.description: Policy-controlled AI assistance levels so a student is not handed a finished solution.
capabilities.evidence: No assistance-level concept exists.
capabilities.known_limitations: Design-only.

capabilities.name: Research-to-product pipeline
capabilities.description: Provenance-preserving path from research question to released product.
capabilities.evidence: No pipeline artifact exists. The evidence graph is the correct substrate to carry the chain.
capabilities.known_limitations: Design-only.

capabilities.name: Local model provider (Ollama)
capabilities.description: Run a local model for offline/diagnostic use.
capabilities.evidence: router.rs declares an Ollama provider kind (requires_api_key: false). Governance permits LOCAL_DIAGNOSTIC/NON-GATE use only.
capabilities.known_limitations: MUST NOT be used to declare AGENT-01 passed. Local model availability is not cloud-gate compliance.

capabilities.name: Air-gapped / offline mode
capabilities.description: Operate with no network egress.
capabilities.evidence: docs/AIR_GAPPED.md exists; the SyntheticOffline provider supports deterministic offline operation; no network-policy enforcement layer exists.
capabilities.known_limitations: No egress firewall, no per-project network policy. Design-only beyond the provider double.

capabilities.name: Provider policy (allowed/prohibited, residency, retention, logging)
capabilities.description: Machine-readable provider policy distinct from provider capability.
capabilities.evidence: No provider policy object exists.
capabilities.known_limitations: Design-only. Provider capability and governance are separate concerns and must not be conflated.

capabilities.name: Container-sandboxed execution
capabilities.description: Candidate execution in a throwaway container with only its worktree writable.
capabilities.evidence: core/sandbox.rs container_argv + SandboxedWorktreeVerifier; tests assert the mount policy.
capabilities.known_limitations: Requires a container runtime on the host; falls back to worktree-only otherwise.

summary.note: Counts are computed from the entries above. TESTED means exercised by a committed test; RUNTIME_VERIFIED means exercised against a real process/network/filesystem with the outcome captured. No entry claims a rung above what this session's evidence supports.
